title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-18
source: AUD. Recorded on cassette tape by Jim Cooper > Hitachi Trq-222, 2 unidentified mikes. Transferred > Sony tc we475 > dbx 2231 EQ > sony rcd w500c > CDR > WAV > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Enthusiastic fan recounts a great night despite a bomb scare, with no noted recording issues
ai_review.review: The reviewer describes an unforgettable show, highlighting the excitement of hearing many songs for the first time and even mentioning a bomb scare that forced the audience to leave the theatre during the NRPS set. No technical details about the recording are provided, but the overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive.

ai_rating.rationale: The single 5‑star review indicates a highly enjoyable performance; lacking recording comments, we assume an average technical quality, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments on sound clarity or mix; reviewers did not discuss recording quality.
